name: kc-order-import-tool
description: Tool for importing orders into KC from a Matrixify export
summary: Transforms Shopify order exports into a format that Khaos Control can process for sales orders. Operations teams use it to filter, validate, and convert orders from multiple sales channels, ensuring only paid and approved orders are imported smoothly into the system. This removes manual reformatting work and helps keep order data consistent across platforms.
